props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially-open value(s) when uncontrolled (no v-model).

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow multiple sections open at once (default single-open).

props.name: value
props.description: Unique key for this section (used by v-model).

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon (registered name).

props.name: name
props.description: Optional readable prefix for the auto-generated (already unique) ARIA ids.

props.name: allowCustomValue
props.description: Accept a value the user typed that is not in `options` (free text).

props.name: color
props.description: Focus-ring accent (the resting border/text stay neutral). Default 'default'.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Debounce the `@search` emit by N ms; the input text still updates instantly (a responsive field). 0 (default) emits on every keystroke — set e.g. 300 for remote sources so you fetch once the user pauses, not per keypress.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text below the field (hidden when `error` is set).

props.name: loading
props.description: Async data source: show a loading spinner in the dropdown (instead of `noResultText`) while a remote `@search` request is in flight. Drive it from your fetch — set true when the request starts, false when the results land.

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Text under the loading spinner. Default '加载中…'.

props.name: manualFilter
props.description: Skip built-in label filtering — you control `options` from `@search` (remote/async suggestions). Default false (client-side filter).

props.name: rounded
props.description: Corner radius. When unset it follows the nearest KunUIConfigProvider's `rounded`. `full` means a pill, which is only defined for the single-line trigger — the floating panel falls back to `lg`, because `9999px` on an n-row panel is clamped by the browser to half its short side. Every other bucket applies to both.

events.name: search
events.description: The field text, debounced by `debounce`. One emit per committed word during IME composition, not one per romaji keystroke.

events.name: select
events.description: The option the user committed by click or Enter. Free text accepted through `allowCustomValue` does not emit it.

slots.name: option
slots.type: { option: KunAutocompleteOption; index: number; active: boolean; selected: boolean; }

props.name: user
props.description: Nullable — upstream user hydration can return a missing brief; Avatar falls back to a deterministic sticker.

props.name: disableFloating
props.description: Accepted but unused (kept so existing call sites don't TS-error).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the group (default derived from the count).

props.name: total
props.description: Grand total for the "+N" overflow chip. Defaults to users.length, so the overflow shows even without passing it explicitly.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name (e.g. "5 条未读"). Without an anchor slot the badge renders standalone (inline), not as a corner overlay.

props.name: rel
props.description: `rel` for the rendered link. Replaces the default rather than adding to it, matching NuxtLink: with `target="_blank"` and no `rel`, KunUI emits `noopener noreferrer`; passing `rel="noopener"` emits exactly that, which is how you keep the `Referer` header (analytics on the other side count the visit as a referral instead of direct traffic). `noopener` is still added back to any `_blank` link unless the value contains the spec's `opener` token; `rel=""` removes the attribute entirely.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the group (role="group").

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding. Default `lg` (24px).

events.name: click
events.description: The card's native click. Emitted in all three render modes (div / button / link), so a plain `<KunCard @click>` works.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Autoplay interval in ms (0 = off). Pauses on hover/focus, off under reduced-motion.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between slides (any CSS length).

props.name: loop
props.description: Seamless infinite loop via slide repositioning (CSS `order`), no cloned DOM. Autoplay glides past the last slide into the first instead of snapping back. Default `true`; auto-disabled when there are too few slides to loop cleanly.

props.name: slidesPerView
props.description: Slides visible at once (>1 for thumbnail strips).

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text below the control (hidden when `error` is set).

props.name: error
props.description: Error message (red text below + danger box). Takes precedence over description.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Tri-state "some but not all" (e.g. a select-all parent). Visual dash that overrides the check; the underlying input stays unchecked until toggled.

events.name: change
events.description: The new checked state, from a user toggle.

props.name: hideIndicator
props.description: `card` variant only: drop the checkbox-box indicator, signal selection with the tinted border/fill alone (the icon-card look).

props.name: max
props.description: Cap on how many options can be selected at once. A click that would exceed it is blocked and emits `invalid` with `'max-reached'` (already-selected options can still be toggled off).

props.name: rounded
props.description: `card` variant only — it is the only variant with a surface of its own to round. `classic` is a box plus a label, and `pill` is a pill by definition; both ignore this.

events.name: change
events.description: The new selection, after a user toggle only — a programmatic `v-model` write does not emit it.

events.name: invalid
events.description: A click was blocked because it would exceed `max`.

props.name: closable
props.description: Render a × that emits `close` (removable tag — filters, tag inputs).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the dialog.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when `query` is empty (a hint / "recent").

props.name: highlight
props.description: Highlight the query terms in the default item render. Default `true`.

props.name: items
props.description: Results to show: a flat item list (one unlabelled group) OR grouped. You compute these from `v-model:query` — the shell does no matching itself.

props.name: loading
props.description: Async search in flight → a loading state instead of the no-result text.

props.name: noResultText
props.description: Shown when `query` is non-empty but there are no results.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Global open shortcut. `true` (default) = ⌘K / Ctrl-K; a single-char string sets a custom key (still with meta/ctrl); `false` disables it.

events.name: select
events.description: The item the user activated. A disabled item never emits.

events.name: submit
events.description: Enter with nothing to select — no results, or every result disabled. The shell has no search of its own, so this is the only way a consumer can act on the raw query ("search the whole site for …"). Enter over a real result still selects it; put an action row first if you want one that is visible.

props.name: content
props.description: Rendered with v-html — the caller MUST pass trusted/pre-sanitized HTML (KunUI does not sanitize; see docs/architecture.md).

props.name: compact

events.name: close

events.name: select
events.description: The item the user activated. A disabled item never emits.

props.name: copiedText

props.description: Extra classes for the outer wrapper. Use `classNames` to reach the trigger, panel, grid or cells.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-part class hooks (root / trigger / popup / grid / cell), merged after the component's own classes so yours wins the conflict — KunUI's own `rounded-kun-*` / `shadow-kun-*` / `z-kun-*` scales included. There is no `popupWidth`: the panel is always content-width with a 260px floor and never follows the trigger, so a short pill still gets a full calendar.

props.name: color
props.description: Focus-ring accent (the resting border/text stay neutral).

props.description: date-fns pattern for the text shown in the trigger. Defaults follow `precision`.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch the control to its container. Turn it off in a filter bar, so the trigger shrinks to its own content. The wrapper shrink-wraps its widest child, so a long `label` or `error` widens it too — a filter pill wants neither.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon rendered before the value in the trigger — a filter glyph for a filter bar, a category glyph for a field. The trailing calendar glyph is the disclosure indicator and stays either way. Must be one of the bundled icon names.

props.name: placeholder
props.default: '请选择日期' | '请选择月份' | '请选择年份'
props.description: Trigger text when nothing is selected. Defaults follow `precision`.

props.name: precision
props.description: What one click commits: a day, a whole month, or a whole year. The panel opens on the matching grid and the value is the first instant of the period, so `month` emits `'2026-09'` and `year` emits `'2026'`.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Corner radius. Every other bucket applies to both.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: date-fns pattern for the emitted v-model string. Defaults follow `precision`; keep it ISO-shaped so the value parses back.

Only applies to a drawer sitting on the bottom edge — including a `responsive` one that becomes a bottom sheet below `md` — on a touch-primary pointer, and only while the content is scrolled to the top. Ignored when `isDismissable` is `false`.

props.name: title
props.description: Rendered in the header and wired to `aria-labelledby`. Prefer it over `ariaLabel`.

props.description: Which

props.name: description
props.description:
Plain-text body, rendered as one `

`. There is no `description` slot: rich body content goes in the DEFAULT slot, which renders directly under this paragraph. Passing both keeps both.

props.name: icon

props.name: rounded
props.description: Corner radius. When unset it follows the nearest KunUIConfigProvider's `rounded`, not a fixed value.

props.name: title
props.description: Plain-text heading. For markup inside the heading (a link, a badge) use the `title` slot — it renders in the same row, after this text.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment. `solid` / `shadow` fill the box and take a contrast-correct foreground; `flat`, `light` and `bordered` use a soft tint of the colour with dark coloured text.

props.name: autofocus
props.description: Focus the field on mount. Focus is moved with `preventScroll`, so it never jogs the page: an autofocused input inside a popover is at the document origin until Floating UI has positioned it, and letting the browser scroll to it there threw the page to the top.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text below the field (hidden when `error` is set). Canonical name.

props.name: isClearable
props.description: Show an X button to clear the value when non-empty.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Mark the field invalid (danger ring) without showing an error message.

props.name: revealPassword
props.description: For type="password": render an eye toggle to reveal/hide the value.

props.name: rel
props.description: `rel` for the rendered link. Replaces the default rather than adding to it, matching NuxtLink: with `target="_blank"` and no `rel`, KunUI emits `noopener noreferrer`; passing `rel="noopener"` emits exactly that, which is how you keep the `Referer` header (analytics on the other side count the visit as a referral instead of direct traffic). `noopener` is still added back to any `_blank` link unless the value contains the spec's `opener` token; `rel=""` removes the attribute entirely.

props.name: size
props.description: Spinner size (spinner mode only). Default 'md'.

props.name: spinner
props.description: Render a compact spinner icon instead of the full mascot image — for small inline loading states (next to a button, a table cell, etc.).

props.name: src
props.description: Image shown while loading. Defaults to a bundled mascot (base64 data URI — no network request, no consumer asset needed). Pass any URL or data URI to override.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for a dialog that draws its own heading inside the slot instead of passing `title`. Ignored when `title` is set (that wins, via `aria-labelledby`). With neither, KunUI warns in dev.

props.name: description
props.description: Rendered under the title and wired to `aria-describedby` — the supporting line a `role="alertdialog"` is required to point at.

props.name: isCloseRequestDismissable
props.description: Whether a platform close request dismisses the dialog — in practice Android's back button and back gesture, which close the dialog instead of leaving the page (the behaviour a native `<dialog>` already has). Desktop is unaffected: its only close request is Escape, handled separately. Turn this off for a dialog that is bound to a route and should let back navigate. Ignored when `isDismissable` is `false`.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Whether a backdrop click or Escape closes the dialog. `role="alertdialog"` stops the BACKDROP from dismissing (a click that lands on the dim area is not an answer) while Escape still cancels, matching Radix and Reka. Pass `true` to opt the backdrop back in, `false` to turn both off.

props.name: isSwipeDismissable
props.description: Whether dragging the phone sheet downwards dismisses it, and whether the drag handle that advertises the gesture is drawn. Only applies where the sheet exists — `placement="auto"` below `md`, on a touch-primary pointer — and only while the content is scrolled to the top, so a swipe over scrollable content still scrolls it. Follows `isDismissable`, so a `role="alertdialog"` cannot be swiped away any more than it can be clicked away.

props.name: placement
props.description: Vertical alignment of the panel. Default 'auto' — a bottom sheet on phones, a centred dialog from `md` up. Pass 'center' for the pre-2.19 behaviour of centring at every width.

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA role of the panel. Use 'alertdialog' for confirm/destructive prompts that need an immediate response — it also flips the isDismissable default. Default 'dialog'.

props.name: scrollBehavior
props.description: inside (default): the panel body scrolls, capped at 90dvh — 85dvh for an `auto` sheet below `md`, which needs a wider tap-to-dismiss strip above it — and never taller than the visible viewport, so the on-screen keyboard can't bury it. outside: the whole overlay scrolls — for panels taller than the viewport.

props.name: size
props.description: Max width of the panel (full = nearly the whole viewport). Default 'md'.

props.name: title
props.description: Rendered as the panel's `<h2>` and wired to `aria-labelledby`, so the name a screen reader announces is the one on screen. Prefer it over `ariaLabel`.

props.name: isShowSticker
props.description: Show the empty-state image. Default true.

props.name: src
props.description: The empty-state image. Defaults to a bundled mascot (base64 data URI — no network/CDN request). Pass any URL or data URI to override.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the −/+ stepper buttons (default true).

props.description: Helper text below the field (hidden when `error` is set).

props.name: isInvalid

props.name: length
props.description: Number of cells (code length).

props.name: mask
props.description: Render each filled cell as a • (one-time codes / passcodes).

props.name: name
props.description: Native form field name (emits a hidden input mirroring the joined value).

props.name: type
props.description: numeric → digits only + inputmode numeric; text → any single char.

events.name: complete
events.description: Fired once every cell is filled.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the dialog (role="dialog" needs a name).

props.name: autoPosition
props.description: Avoid viewport collisions: flip to the opposite side, shift along the edge, and cap height/width to the available space so tall content scrolls instead of overflowing. Default `true`. Set `false` to honour `position` verbatim.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: `trigger="hover"`: ms grace after leaving (crosses the gap). Default 120.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Make the trigger anchor span its container instead of shrinking to its content. Both wrapper divs switch from `inline-block` to `block w-full`, so a full-width trigger (e.g. a `fullWidth` KunButton or a split button) can actually fill the width. Default `false` (inline, content-width).

props.name: group
props.description: `trigger="hover"`: shared id so a row of menus switches instantly between siblings and only one is open at a time (menu-bar behaviour).

props.name: opaque

Menus/popovers over a busy background usually want this for legibility. Default `false` (follows the global surface opacity). Note: setting `--kun-surface-opacity:1` on the panel yourself does NOT work — Tailwind resolves the themed colour at `:root`.

props.name: openDelay

props.name: showArrow
props.description: Render a caret pointing at the trigger.

props.name: toggle
props.description: `true` (default) = a like/press TOGGLE: pressed state (`aria-pressed`), icon fill + colour, and a celebratory burst. `false` = a one-shot ACTION (share / more …) in the same compact skin — no self-toggle, no burst, just a tactile pop; handle the click with a native `@click`. Lets a whole reactions row use one component instead of mixing in a heavier icon button. In BOTH modes the filled/coloured skin follows the `active` model. So an action-mode reaction can be a controlled "menu button": wrap it as a `KunPopover` trigger, bind `:model-value` to your own state (e.g. 收藏 = "in ≥1 list"), and the click opens the picker instead of self-toggling.

props.name: icon

props.name: loading

props.description: Disable shattering entirely — the content stays put. Default false.

props.name: duration
props.description: Fly-apart duration in ms. Default 1100.

props.name: easing
props.description: Animation-level CSS easing. Default `linear` — the natural ballistic motion is baked into each shard's sampled keyframes, so override this only to time-warp the whole flight.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade shards out as they fly (false = keep full opacity, e.g. flying off-screen). Default true.

props.name: gravity
props.description: Downward gravity pull on the shards (0 = a pure radial burst). Default 1.

props.name: keepSpace
props.description: Keep the original's layout space after it shatters (`visibility:hidden`) instead of collapsing it (`display:none`). Default false.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the break originates — shards fly outward from here. `center` (default), `top`, `pointer` (last pointer position over the content), or `{ x, y }` px.

props.name: pieces
props.description: Target number of glass shards (Voronoi cells); clamped to 2–160. Default 24. Fewer is cheaper to build, but the fly-apart stays compositor-only regardless.

props.name: reassemble
props.description: Animate the re-form when restoring — a reverse "reassemble" where the same shards fly back in from where they scattered and settle into place. `false` snaps the content back instantly. Default true.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Maximum random spin per shard, in degrees. Default 140.

props.name: seed
props.description: Deterministic shard pattern: the same seed reproduces the same break (handy for visual tests). Omit for a fresh random shatter each time.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far the shards travel, as a multiplier. Default 1.

props.name: trigger
props.description: How the break is triggered. `manual` (default) = drive it via `v-model:shattered` or the exposed `shatter()` method; `click` = clicking the content shatters it, and the click point becomes the impact origin.

props.name: zIndex
props.description: z-index of the body-level shard overlay. Default 9999.

events.name: restoreEnd
events.description: The reassemble animation has finished.

events.name: shatterEnd
events.description: The last shard has landed.

events.name: shatterStart
events.description: The shatter animation has begun.

props.name: animation
props.description: Pulse animation (auto-disabled under prefers-reduced-motion); `none` to turn off.

props.name: height
props.description: CSS height. Defaults: text 1em, rect 1.25rem, circle 2.5rem.

props.name: loaded
props.description: When true, render the default slot (real content) instead of the placeholder.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape preset: `rect` block, `text` line, or `circle` (avatar).

props.name: width
props.description: CSS width. Defaults: rect/text 100%, circle = height.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label (role="slider" needs a name).

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text below the track (hidden when `error` is set).

props.name: error
props.description: Error message (red text below + danger fill). Takes precedence over description.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Format the value shown in the tooltip / value readout.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible field label (rendered above the track, associates the slider).

props.name: marks
props.description: Tick marks under the track. Pass numbers (or {value,label}) within [min,max].

props.name: showTooltip
props.description: Show a value bubble above the thumb while hovering / dragging / focused.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Always render the current value next to the label.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired once on commit (pointer release / keyboard), for forms that only care about the final value — `update:modelValue` still streams live.

props.name: current
props.description: 0-based index of the current step; earlier steps render as done.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text below the switch (hidden when `error` is set).

props.name: error
props.description: Error message (red text below). Takes precedence over description.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment of each tab's content (icon + label) inside its box. Mainly visible on vertical / full-width tabs, where the box is wider than its content.

props.name: name
props.description: ARIA id namespace shared with <KunTabPanel> (so a tab links to its panel via aria-controls/labelledby). Set a distinct `name` per tab group on a page.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Horizontal tabs ALWAYS contain their overflow (they scroll inside the container instead of widening the page) — no flag needed. This opts a *vertical* tab column into scrolling when it outgrows a bounded height.

props.name: scrollButtons
props.description: When a horizontal tab strip overflows, float a chevron button on each scrollable edge (in addition to the always-on edge fade). Set false to keep just the fade — the strip still scrolls via swipe / wheel / keyboard. Default true.

slots.name: tab
slots.type: { item: KunTabItem; index: number; active: boolean; }

props.name: value
props.description: Which tab this panel belongs to (matches a KunTabItem `value`).

props.name: active
props.description: The active tab value. Optional when wrapped in <KunTabPanels> (inherited).

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Alias for mount="eager" — familiar from Radix/Reka/MUI.

props.name: hiddenStrategy
props.description: How inactive eager/lazy panels hide. until-found (default) keeps them findable by in-page search + deep links; display is plain display:none.

props.name: loading
props.description: Mark this panel as loading (async / lazy data still resolving). Dims the panel to 0.5 opacity, makes it inert (no pointer/keyboard interaction) and sets aria-busy for screen readers. The dim uses a *delayed* fade (the React useDeferredValue trick) so a fast load finishes before it becomes visible — no flicker; only a genuinely slow load dims. This is the "stale-while- revalidate" mechanism only: the library dims what's there, YOU decide when `loading` is true and render the skeleton (e.g. via <KunSkeleton>) for a first load where there is no prior content to dim.

props.name: mount
props.description: eager: SSR all panels, hide inactive (SEO-optimal, default). lazy: render on first activation then keep. unmount: only active in DOM.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the bordered field. Use `classNames` to reach the outer wrapper, the tags or the text input.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-part class hooks, merged after the component's own classes so yours wins the conflict — KunUI's own `rounded-kun-*` / `shadow-kun-*` scales included.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text below the field (hidden when `error` is set). Canonical name.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Radius of the field. It deliberately does not reach the tags: a tag IS a `<KunChip>` and stays a pill at every setting, so a `KunChip` next to the field and a tag inside it never disagree. Reach a tag with `classNames.chip`.

events.name: add
events.description: A tag that passed every check and is now in the model.

events.name: invalid
events.type: reason: KunTagInputInvalidReason, raw: string, detail?: string
events.description: Why an entry was rejected, plus the raw text. `detail` carries the message returned by a `validate` function.

events.name: remove
events.description: The tag that was removed and the index it held.

slots.name: tag
slots.type: { tag: string; index: number; remove: () => void; }

props.name: autofocus
props.description: Focus the field on mount. Focus is moved with `preventScroll`, so it never jogs the page: an autofocused input inside a popover is at the document origin until Floating UI has positioned it, and letting the browser scroll to it there threw the page to the top.

props.name: color
props.description: Focus-ring accent (the resting border/text stay neutral). Default 'default'.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text below the field (hidden when `error` is set). Canonical name.

props.name: color
props.description: Dot / medallion colour.

props.name: icon
props.description: Registered icon name → renders a medallion instead of a plain dot.

props.name: showArrow
props.description: Render a caret pointing at the trigger.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text below the dropzone. Canonical name.

events.name: setImage
events.description: The cropped image, once the user applies the crop.

props.name: isNavigation
props.description: When true (default) and the user has an id, the whole chip is a real <a>/link to the user's profile (crawlable, name as anchor text).
